# External / uploaded files

Drop files uploaded into the chat or copied from your own machine here.

Keep a note of where each came from — accession, database, date, URL. Alignments and
conservation scores depend on which database version they were built from, and that is
impossible to reconstruct later.

Expected contents (see `docs/04_data_inventory.md`):

- aRES sequences: *E. coli* UC5, *K. pneumoniae* S_34AVR, *E. chengduensis* GN04826
- aRad1b sequence (needed for the T0 pipeline validation)
- T7 gp5 (UniProt P00581) and *E. coli* TrxA
- PDB 1T7P
- Paper supplementary Tables S2 / S3 / S4
- Any existing AlphaFold models and HADDOCK setup from the run already in progress
